settings.question: How do I clean and care for my wooden trivet set?
settings.answer: Simply wipe clean with a soft, slightly damp cloth after use. Do not submerge in water or place in the dishwasher. To keep the wood looking rich and vibrant for years, you can apply a drop of food-safe mineral oil or cutting board wax once or twice a year.

settings.question: What is the maximum heat resistance?
settings.answer: Our solid natural wood trivets are naturally heat-resistant up to 450°F (232°C). They safely handle cast iron skillets, boiling kettles, Dutch ovens, and sizzling casserole dishes straight off the stove or oven.
